diagnosis.originalGoal: Materialize matching row pairs and inspect each unmatched or conflicting occurrence.
diagnosis.proposedGoal: Decide which product keys need correction, retaining every source occurrence for review.

decision.reason: No repeated exception key reduces the number of decision records; retain the original review contract.

contract.original: One review item per unmatched source row or conflicting matched row pair.
contract.reframed: One proposed corrective action per exact key, retaining every underlying original occurrence reference.
contract.limitation: Grouping changes the unit of work. Fewer action records do not establish equal reviewer effort, correct resolution, time savings, or superiority on the original pairwise-output task.

limitations.supportedTask: Exact string identifiers; compare shared non-identifier column names. No fuzzy matching or automatic correction.
limitations.sourceRows: Data rows are numbered from 1 after the header. Quoted multiline cells are one data row.
limitations.duplicates: Duplicate identifiers retain every matching pair; they are never silently deduplicated.
limitations.csvSafety: CSV cells starting with formula characters receive a leading apostrophe. Workspace retains exact originals.
